name: Seyra, Rubyfront of Nova Kai
summary: The Auros tutorial's Rubyfront: it gains HP every time something stops in Stasis.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: This game you put at least 2 opposing Entities into Stasis. Put an Object you control into your Retire Zone, then flip.

faceA.name: Seyra, Rubyfront of Nova Kai

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 13 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: Each time an Entity enters Stasis, you gain 1 HP.

hold.name: Grip of the Vigil
hold.text: an Entity you control gains Stasis until your next turn.

faceA.flavor: Nova Kai does not sleep. She counts the hours for everyone.

faceB.name: Vigil of Nova Kai

effect.text: Each time an Entity enters Stasis, you gain 2 HP.

vigilHold.name: Perennial Grip
vigilHold.text: an Entity you control gains Stasis.

vigilWake.name: Armed Awakening
vigilWake.text: untap an Auros Entity you control: it gets +2 Power until end of turn.

vigilSeal.name: Seal of the Vigil
vigilSeal.text: put up to 2 opposing Entities into Stasis.

faceB.flavor: When the vigil ends, only what stopped remains.
